pharma.heading: Distribution control, documents and training, on one platform.
pharma.summary: For pharma manufacturers, distributors and medical device companies: connect distribution tracking, compliance documentation and workforce training into one operating model built for regulated environments.
pharma.challengesTitle: The bottlenecks life sciences operators describe to us
pharma.challengesSummary: Six patterns we see repeatedly in pharmaceutical and life sciences operations. Each one is solvable with technology you can run without a research team.
pharma.ch1Desc: Batch movements between plants, distributors and points of sale are tracked in separate systems, so traceability investigations take days instead of minutes.
pharma.ch2Title: Compliance documents are re-keyed by hand
pharma.ch2Desc: Certificates of analysis, batch records and regulatory submissions are typed into multiple portals, so documentation errors cause delays and rework.
pharma.ch3Desc: Temperature excursions during storage and transit are reviewed after delivery, so compromised batches reach customers before anyone acts.
pharma.ch4Desc: GxP and SOP training is tracked in spreadsheets and LMS exports, so audit readiness depends on manual reconciliation across teams.
pharma.ch5Title: Quality events have no visible owner
pharma.ch5Desc: Deviations, CAPAs and complaints move between departments by email, so escalation happens by chasing and timelines slip.
pharma.ch6Desc: Regulatory and management reports are assembled manually from multiple sources, so the numbers are always one cycle behind the operation.
pharma.solutionsSummary: Connected platforms and tailored solutions that turn life sciences operations into a system your teams can run and your auditors can trust.
pharma.sol1Desc: End-to-end batch tracking across plants, distributors and points of sale, with traceability investigations that resolve in minutes.
pharma.sol2Desc: Extraction of certificates, batch records and submission data with confidence thresholds and a reviewer queue, integrated to your regulatory portals.
pharma.sol3Desc: Real-time temperature and location tracking with excursion alerts routed to the right team before a compromised batch is delivered.
pharma.sol4Desc: GxP and SOP training records, assignments and renewals in one system, so audit readiness is a report rather than a project.
pharma.sol5Desc: Deviations, CAPAs and complaints on a routed workflow with SLA timers, ownership and a full audit trail.
pharma.sol6Desc: One reconciled operational dataset, so regulatory submissions and management reports run on current numbers without manual rebuilds.
pharma.capabilitiesSummary: The engineering and delivery capabilities we apply to build, integrate and operate life sciences platforms your teams can rely on.
pharma.cap1Desc: Operations consoles, training portals and mobile apps built for regulated, audit-sensitive environments.
pharma.cap2Desc: APIs, events and batch reconciliation between ERP, WMS, LMS, quality and regulatory systems.
pharma.cap3Desc: Document extraction and anomaly detection with confidence thresholds and human review built in.
pharma.cap4Desc: Functional, integration and validation testing appropriate to regulated workloads.
pharma.cap5Desc: Environment separation, release pipelines and monitoring with controlled change management.
pharma.cap6Desc: L1–L3 support with agreed service windows for systems in daily operational use.
pharma.ctaEyebrow: Build for the audit, not the fire drill
pharma.ctaDesc: Book a focused walkthrough with a senior MeU life sciences specialist. You see the platform against your distribution, your documents and your training records, not a generic pitch.
